task_sufficiency: Minimum context must retain the current task's decision-relevant questions, conditions and downstream uses. Available software handlers constrain execution, not the scientific planning scope. Preserve explicit local omissions instead of silently removing needed outputs. Do not include an unrelated workflow connection graph.
host_retention: Full inputs, immutable provenance and audit remain bound on host; model exposure is task-specific.
identifiers: Expose only identifiers needed for scientific identity, relations, attribution or valid response fields; retain their definitions. Mechanical archive/chunk/config identifiers stay host unless explicitly needed.
forbidden_shortcuts: dropping required rule clauses or exceptions
semantic changes labeled as exact deduplication
claiming token or response quality from character count
required_audit: retained rule identities and operative clause comparison
actual prompt character count and explicit tokenizer status

requirements_planning.purpose: Plan reusable input requirements and conditions, not dataset assignment or availability.
model_needs: all supplied applicable rule clauses and unresolved constraints
selected method input definitions and conditional alternatives
task-relevant design distinctions only; full per-table inventory and source notes belong to later source assessment
requirements_planning.evidence_boundary: Reuse authoritative context and constraints. Planning orientation cannot imply coverage, joins, matching or new obligations; the host retains all source inventory and note history.

source_assessment.purpose: Assess assigned source records against requirements without inventing requirements or replacing complete evidence with top-k retrieval.
model_needs: all permitted source fragments for the assigned assessment
source/record identity, units, conditions and conflicting evidence
source_assessment.evidence_boundary: No source-unit pruning; exact duplicates may share text only when each occurrence identity and scope remain explicit.

source_review.purpose: Independently compare the assigned candidate against the complete authorized source basis and review criteria.
model_needs: candidate and expected output record identities
complete assigned source units including counterevidence
applicable processing rules and authority/permission boundaries
assigned review dimension and output contract
source_review.evidence_boundary: Do not substitute the candidate, upstream summary or retrieved top-k for independent full-source evidence.

source_transform.purpose: Perform the assigned extraction, planning or source transformation within its explicit source access scope.
model_needs: assigned instructions and relevant processing rules
complete source units needed by the assigned transformation
source roles and location/identity needed for the output
source_transform.evidence_boundary: Keep complete assigned extraction evidence. File registration does not grant permission to read attachment bodies.

impact_advice.purpose: Explain consequences and next actions from accepted coverage and recorded gaps.
model_needs: accepted coverage, requirement definitions and every assigned gap
source scope and required assessment links
impact_advice.evidence_boundary: Do not re-open raw data, redo coverage, invent missing evidence or treat proposed alternatives as confirmed usable.

accepted_summary.purpose: Explain accepted assessment and decisions to the user without new findings.
model_needs: references explicitly required by the output contract
accepted_summary.evidence_boundary: No raw tables, complete method library or unrelated rules; do not change the accepted scientific conclusion.

access_classification.purpose: Classify source roles and access permissions without inspecting unapproved bodies.
model_needs: assigned file metadata and requested source role
existing restrictions and required identity references
access_classification.evidence_boundary: Unregistered or held-out sources do not become accessible by similarity or retrieval.

preparation.purpose: Perform the assigned source preparation or bounded review of deterministic preparation.
model_needs: source values, units and experimental-unit identity needed for this operation
deterministic checks and unresolved changes requiring review
preparation.evidence_boundary: Preserve raw values, BLQ/missingness distinctions and conflicts; no invented identifiers, joins or imputation.

handoff_review.purpose: Review the assigned prepared handoff and unresolved limitations.
model_needs: prepared candidate and declared source bindings
assigned review evidence and validation findings
applicable handoff rules and unresolved limitations
handoff_review.evidence_boundary: A partial/historical checkpoint is not a newly approved complete assessment.

eda_plan.purpose: Act as EP, the EDA planner. Start from the admitted Data handoff, objective, applicable rules and bound scientific reference. For objective-relevant data with limitations, propose a feasible scoped display before discussing unavailable analyses. A limitation on matching, pooling, conversion, fitting or time-axis reconciliation does not by itself prohibit separate descriptive displays. Specify usable observations, axes, grouping, uncertainty or status marks, and caption limits. Keep a needed figure as DEFERRED when its renderer is unavailable and provide an informative source-table fallback where permitted; do not omit the data solely for that reason. Only mark an operation executable when its scientific inputs and an explicit R handler are available. Do not calculate, repeat Data assessments, invent values or relationships, or relax existing Rules.
model_needs: compact downstream decision needs and the conditional candidate catalogue; trace each relevant candidate to planned evidence or an explicit scoped omission
applicable G001-G008 and explicitly scoped EDA rules
output contract and disclosed transport limits
eda_plan.evidence_boundary: Admitted Data scope, definitions, restrictions, objective, supplied downstream uses and bound reference remain authoritative. Implementation capability does not establish scientific applicability or erase a needed question. An omitted fixture source is not project-wide absence. No generated results, parameter or target fitting, findings or human approval.

eda_findings.purpose: You are the EDA interpreter. Start from the supplied plan, host results, plotted rows and metadata. State supported observations, limitations and downstream implications. Do not recompute results, reread unrelated sources, fit models or repeat Data assessments.
model_needs: applicable G001-G008 and explicitly scoped EDA rules
output contract and disclosed transport limits
eda_findings.evidence_boundary: Plan, supplied R results and plot evidence with their source identities; absent rows or images remain unreviewed. Quote host results only.

eda_review.purpose: You are the independent EDA reviewer. Compare the supplied plan, calculations, figure evidence and findings with the objective and applicable rules. Report concrete issues and affected artifacts once. Do not rewrite findings, start corrections, grant human approval or assemble the handoff.
model_needs: applicable G001-G008 and explicitly scoped EDA rules
output contract and disclosed transport limits
eda_review.evidence_boundary: All supplied review evidence including counterevidence and open items. Paths alone are not inspected images or result rows. Human confirmation and handoff assembly remain host-only.

context_sufficiency.purpose: Assess each declared need against its criteria, visible project view and method evidence. Return supported, partial or unsupported with exact citations; never infer missing project observations.
context_sufficiency.evidence_boundary: Only the packed evidence for this check is visible. No retrieval, tools, approval or generation of scientific results.

eda_finalize.purpose: Act as EP after EC. Review the supplied calculation results once and finalize display specifications for EV. Preserve all source records, units, identities, statuses and scientific limitations. Use only the implemented display operations. Do not recompute, retry EC, re-extract Data, fit models, retrieve information, inspect files or claim visual inspection. Return concise English JSON; report blocked or unsupported displays without blocking unrelated usable tasks.
model_needs: unchanged applicable Rules and output contract
eda_finalize.evidence_boundary: One post-EC display review; unchanged source results and Rules; no calculation, extraction, automatic retry or image inspection.

retrieval: An explicit unanswered task question is required. Existing task definitions do not trigger duplicate background retrieval; zero external background is valid.

handoff_projection.scope: Existing task profiles; all 33 routes including EDA remain explicit.
handoff_projection.impact_advice: Keep accepted coverage status, every shortage and source scope, original/counterevidence, requirements and exact candidate method conditions/alternatives/limitations. Method bibliography and content-integrity lineage stay host-side; they are not additional method authority.
handoff_projection.published_rule_handoff: Downstream preparation, handoff, impact and source assessment consume host-verified published Rules. When each rule carries project_rules_ref and projection_version, source derivation/routing audit stays host-side. All operative clauses, conditions, exceptions, requirement, usage, stages and context_path stay visible. This never applies to arbitrary source/candidate records or their contrary evidence.
handoff_projection.accepted_summary: Preserve complete supplied conclusions, readiness, affected scope, holds, conditions, uncertainty, next actions and material numbers. No new source review or raw library is requested.
handoff_projection.protected_evidence: Coverage, independent review, DP/DH supplied record scope, and all EDA supplied handoff/plan/calculation/figure/findings evidence are complete task inputs. No additional record selection, counterevidence pruning, source joins or applicability inference.
handoff_projection.exact_deduplication: Only exact repeated text may share a local descriptive definition. Retain every occurrence identity/scope, original output selectors and exact expansion; cross-scope matching is never inferred.

task_orchestration.scope: All registered routes; future steps require explicit profile and stage adapter registration.

rule_collections.unpublished_policy: Retain derivation evidence unless the stage explicitly consumes an admitted bound project Rule collection.
rule_collections.independent_review_policy: Do not remove source or candidate evidence from independent review.

task_orchestration.reference_selection: Only explicitly catalogued method-reference fields may be scoped. All global constraints and transitive dependencies remain. Rules, source evidence and upstream results are never selectable.
task_orchestration.zero_retrieval: Default. Upstream outputs go directly into the next task input; they are not retrieved or summarized again.
